problems.detail: idempotentReplayInterceptor only substitutes the cached reply when box.response !== undefined, so a genuinely cached reply whose value is literally undefined (a void-output procedure) would fall through to the 500 instead of being treated as a cache hit. No such procedure exists in the contract today and no test exercises this, so it does not affect the current fix, but it is a latent gap in the 'genuine cache hit' detection worth a sentinel value instead of undefined if a void-output idempotent mutation is ever added.
